title: Regulation & Market Theory
intro: This level covers the EU rulebook in depth (MiFID II/MiFIR, MAR, PRIIPs, UCITS/AIFMD II, CSDR, EMIR, SFTR, SRD II, RIS) and compares it with the US, UK, Swiss and Asian regimes. It also covers term structure, portfolio theory, market microstructure and multivariable calculus.

modules.title: EU deep dive: the rulebook behind every EU securities workflow
boss_items: best execution / dealer execution across venues
